verdict.rationale: BugSnag's grouping docs say grouping gives 'a clear view of which issues are having the biggest impact on your users'. A hands-on community user praises being able to track how many users are affected by a particular bug. Stability scoring measures the share of sessions that are error-free, but only at the project level, not per issue. missing for 10: first-party documentation of per-issue affected-user counts, per-issue affected-session counts, sorting or prioritizing the inbox by users/sessions rather than event count, and recent independent corroboration (the community report is old).
